mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, type, title, description, `read`, create_time FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET `read` = 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND `read` = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM notification WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND `read` = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (user_id, type, title, description, `read`, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{description}, #{read}, #{createTime})
